reception.title: Virtual reception
reception.lead: The official way to send an appeal to the rector and university leadership remotely.

steps.title: Write your appeal
steps.text: In the form below, enter your full name, phone and e-mail, choose the leader your appeal is addressed to, and describe the matter.

steps.title: Get a number
steps.text: After sending, your appeal receives a number — keep it.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: The appeal is forwarded to the relevant unit and reviewed within the period set by law (usually within 15 days).

steps.title: Receive a reply
steps.text: The reply is delivered to the e-mail or phone you provided.

rules: Give your real name and contact details — otherwise we cannot reply.
Describe the matter briefly and clearly; attach a document if needed (PDF, image, Word, up to 10 MB).
Do not send repeat appeals on the same matter — ask about it using your appeal number.
In urgent cases call the hotline or the reception.

corpMail.helpText: If you have trouble signing in or with your password, contact the ICT centre.

access.title: Password
access.text: Change the temporary password you were given at first sign-in. Use at least 8 characters mixing letters, digits and symbols.

access.title: Devices
access.text: Use a browser or a mail app (IMAP/SMTP) on your phone or computer; ask the ICT centre for the settings.

rules: The mailbox is for official correspondence only.
Never share your password — university staff will not ask for it either.
Do not open links or files from unknown senders — it may be phishing.
When you leave the university the mailbox is deleted: save important messages beforehand.
